Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.
2. Heard Sri Prem Prakash Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant; Sri Manav Chaurasia, learned AGA for the State-respondent.

3. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
49 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Ghorawal, District Sonbhadra, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the daughter of the informant on 2.12.2021 and even after delivery of a child, applicant used to torture the daughter of the informant for want of dowry and on 16.3.2023,
informant received information that his daughter died by hanging herself.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused in the present matter.
6.

He further submitted that actually applicant did the job of labour in Goa and after delivery of a child, deceased i.e. his wife insisted him to live in Goa but when applicant refused, then in anger, she committed suicide by hanging herself.
7.
He further submitted that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that she died due to hanging.
8. He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 19.3.2023 i.e. for last more than one and half years.

9. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that neither in the FIR nor in the statement recorded under section 161 Cr.P.C. there is any specific allegation of demand of dowry and deceased died due to hanging.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
11.

However, it reflects that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but neither in the FIR nor in the statement recorded during investigation,
informant disclosed any specific demand of dowry and therefore, it appears that FIR of the present case has been lodged on the basis of vague allegation of demand of dowry.
Further, considering the fact that deceased died due to hanging, defence taken by learned counsel for the applicant, in the instant bail application, cannot be ruled out, at this stage.
12. Further applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 19.3.2023 i.e for last more than one and half years.

13. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
14. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

15. Let the applicant- Shere Ali @ Shere Alam @ Bauva, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-

2 (i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
